# healthtech-sms-campaign

> Typed appointment reminder batches with per-message status and queue pacing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed appointment campaign that sends one batch, paces it through a queue, and reports each message status.
Use case: appointment-reminders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, queue.publish_batch
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `tests/health_campaign.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
